standard_name: DEMO STANDARD: ASME Y14.5 / ISO 2768 Precision Mechanical Rules
description: Demonstration rules for precision mechanical machining tolerances, pressure vessel bounds, and surface finish.

rules.description: Precision engineering tolerance must not exceed ±0.05 mm.
Pneumatic/Hydraulic piping design pressure must not exceed 16 bar rating.
Bearing journal surface finish roughness Ra must be at or below 1.6 μm.
